Tools and oils for maintaining weapons. 
 
Minimum condition for repair: 50%

Sewing tools for maintaining armor and helmets. 
 
Minimum condition for repair: 50%

%c[255,170,220,255]Repair kits%c[default] 
Weapon and sewing repair kits have two uses each. The weapon kit repairs weapons, and the sewing kit repairs armor and helmets. Use RMB to choose suitable gear from the inventory or drag the kit onto the desired item. 

%c[255,120,210,120]Effect: up to +20 percentage points of condition per use.%c[default] 
A kit works at 50% condition or higher, but below 100%. Repairs can fully restore an item without exceeding 100% condition. The kit description shows the number of uses remaining. 

%c[255,255,190,90]Metal part%c[default] 
It works only on a weapon displaying 90–99% condition. It adds 2 percentage points, up to a maximum of 100%, and is consumed after the repair.

Unneeded items can be disassembled at the workbench under "CRAFT", in "DISASSEMBLE" mode. Artifact detectors and stash metal detectors can only be disassembled at the workbench. Weapons, armor and helmets can also be disassembled with a disassembly kit, which has five uses.

Only items in the backpack are available at the workbench. Items in equipment slots or on the belt are protected from disassembly. The selected item is destroyed after successful disassembly.

Possible materials and their quantities are shown in the interface. Materials are granted in a fixed quantity or within the stated range. Loading a save does not change the result.

Disassembling a weapon returns its last non-unique upgrade and its unique anomalous modules.

%c[255,170,220,255]Discharge%c[default]
An active detector gradually drains its charge. The PDA warns you at 25%, and an empty detector switches off. A stowed device does not drain during normal use. Fast travel to a radio beacon also reduces detector charge, including stowed devices.

A full charge lasts 90 minutes of active use for the Echo, 60 for the Bear, 45 for the Veles and 30 for the Svarog. For stash metal detectors: Homemade lasts 60 minutes, Wave 45 and Magnet 30. These are minutes of active device use, not hours on the game calendar.

%c[255,120,210,120]Krona battery: +15 minutes of operation.%c[default]
It charges both device families. Drag the battery onto a detector or select the desired device through RMB. Charge cannot exceed full capacity.

%c[255,255,190,90]Maintenance%c[default]
Detectors can only be disassembled at the workbench under "CRAFT", in "DISASSEMBLE" mode. Unequip the device and move it to your backpack first. Possible materials and quantities are shown at the workbench; the result is tied to the individual device and does not change after loading a save.
A bloodsucker may yield a jaw and up to two pieces of meat. Scientists especially value the jaw. The meat can be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
A boar may yield hooves and up to two meat chops. Hooves can be sold or traded, while the meat can be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
A chimera yields claws and meat, among the most expensive mutant trophies. Its meat can also be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
Blind dogs sometimes yield a saleable tail and small pieces of meat. The meat can be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
Flesh eyes are research and trade trophies. Its meat can be sold or traded, or cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
Pseudodog tails and meat are worth more than the corresponding blind-dog trophies. Psy-dogs yield the same parts more often. The meat can be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
A tushkano may yield a bone growth and a small piece of meat. The trophies can be sold or traded, and the meat can also be cooked at a placed campfire and eaten.
